grammar.name: Line 1.75 round
grammar.summary: 1.75 stroke at 24 (1.5 on 16 masters, 2 on spots), round caps and joins, container radius 2 (below 8: 1), straight segments at 0/30/45/60/90/120/135/150 plus circular arcs and free curves, clear gap >= 2.25, at most 4 parts beside the main outline, no signature detail; filled only for selected navigation, toggles that are on and the four status icons at 16 px

signature.name: none
signature.description: No signature detail. Direction A (D36) gives every colour one job and allows no ornament without data, so icons stay plain function signs; identity comes from the colour rule, Radio Canada and the app signs. Filled dots exist only as punctuation (i, !, ?, keyboard keys, image light: d 2.5) and as overflow dots (d 3), listed in grammar_fills.
